source:
@@U00309@@
“In the beginning was the Deed!” If we're to share this room, poodle, you'll have to put an end to this howling and growling! I can’t manage so distracting a companion. One of us will have to leave. And as much as I hate to be an ungracious host, there’s the door, it’s open, you're free to go. But what’s this? What am I seeing? Can it be? Is it real? Is it an illusion? How long and broad my poodle’s growing! It rises a monstrosity! This is no longer the shape of a dog! What sort of specter have I taken in? He’s already the size of a hippopotamus, eyes like torches, terrible fangs! Ah! I know you now! The key of Solomon’s the thing to handle you.

@@U00310@@
(SPIRITS are heard in the corridor outside.)

@@U00312@@
One we know well Is caught fast within there. Mind what you're doing, No one go in there! An old lynx of Hell, Like a fox in a gin, there Is quaking and stewing. Have a care! Have a care! Unseen, through the air, Flit now and hover, To and fro, round about, Now under, now over,
translation:
@@U00309@@
“一开始就是契约！”如果我们要共用这个房间，贵宾犬，你就必须停止这种嚎叫和咆哮！我受不了一个如此分散注意力的同伴。我们中的一个人将不得不离开。尽管我讨厌成为一个不友善的主人，但门已经开着，你可以自由走动。但这是什么？我看到了什么？可以吗？这是真的吗？难道是幻觉？我的贵宾犬长得多长多宽啊！它崛起为一个怪物！这已经不是狗的形状了！我中了什么样的鬼魂？他已经有河马那么大了，眼睛像火把，獠牙可怕！啊!我现在认识你了！所罗门的关键在于对付你。

@@U00310@@
（外面走廊里传来鬼魂的声音。）

@@U00312@@
我们熟悉的一个被牢牢地困在那里。小心你在做什么，没有人进去！地狱里的一只老山猫， 就像杜松子酒里的狐狸， 颤抖着，正在沸腾。保重！保重！看不见，穿过空气，现在飞过，盘旋，来来回回，一会儿在下面，一会儿在上面，
